reference_sql:
SELECT t.store_code, t.n_orders
FROM (
  -- one row per store with orders
  SELECT s.store_code, s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.country_code
) AS t
WHERE t.n_orders > (
  SELECT AVG(t2.n_orders)
  FROM (
    -- one row per store with orders
    SELECT s2.store_code, s2.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
    FROM orders o2
    JOIN stores s2 ON s2.store_id = o2.store_id
    GROUP BY s2.store_code, s2.country_code
  ) AS t2
  WHERE t2.country_code = t.country_code
)

SELECT so.store_code, so.n_orders
FROM store_orders so
WHERE so.n_orders > (
  SELECT AVG(so2.n_orders)
  FROM store_orders so2
  WHERE so2.country_code = so.country_code
)

WITH store_orders AS (
  -- one row per store with orders
  SELECT s.store_code, s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.country_code
),
country_avg AS (
  -- one row per country
  SELECT country_code, AVG(n_orders) AS avg_orders
  FROM store_orders
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT so.store_code, so.n_orders
FROM store_orders so
JOIN country_avg ca ON ca.country_code = so.country_code
WHERE so.n_orders > ca.avg_orders

solver.query:
WITH so AS (SELECT s.store_code, s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code, s.country_code)
SELECT store_code, n_orders FROM so WHERE n_orders > (SELECT AVG(x.n_orders) FROM so x WHERE x.country_code = so.country_code)
